** Major** · **Stability & Availability** · **Quick win** **Do not let a correlation-read failure abort an admitted repair.** If comment pagination fails after the owner records `dispatched`, the exception fails this step before the repair agent starts. Normal admission will not dispatch that attempt again. The pinned `github-script` action reports uncaught exceptions as failures, while the admission planner treats dispatched attempts as spent. Handle correlation-read failures as warnings, like comment-write failures, or provide recovery that retries the same admitted run. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/actions/github-script/f28e40c7f34bde8b3046d885e986cb6290c5673b/src/main.ts))

finding.body:
** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Select attempts by their reconciled state.** After `claimed(A)` followed by `rejected(A)`, this search still selects the historical claim. A manual `ci-fix` invocation without correlation inputs then appends `dispatched(A)`. The canonical receipt reader rejects `rejected → dispatched` and treats the PR's receipt history as conflicting, including when admitting later HEADs. Fold observations by attempt first. Require the latest state to be `claimed` or `ambiguous`, including when `requestedAttempt` is supplied. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kodmial/continuum/7d46e7c81755cb716b902a4b7526f02bec3a0f8b/.github/workflows/continuum-opencode.yml))
